title: Purported AI-Cloned Voice Depicts Kenyan President William Ruto Speaking French in Viral Video

behaviors.text: The reportedly manipulated version used AI-generated French audio over the original video, making it a case of voice cloning rather than a full audiovisual deepfake.
A purportedly AI-manipulated video widely shared on TikTok and Facebook presents Kenyan President a person speaking in French during a speech in Tokyo on February 7, 2024.
